intro: Lead in comfort, work in style. With height-adjustable lumbar support, an optional neck rest, and a quilted leatherette seat, this chair offers unmatched support—perfect for those who take charge.

features.title: The right recline support for you
features.text: The 360° swivel and centre tilt mechanism with adjustable tension help you move naturally while providing steady back support—keeping you active without sacrificing comfort.

features.title: Comfortable quilted back
features.text: The back is made up of injection moulded glass filled nylon & upholstered using Quilted leatherette fabric.It embodies the players who cant wait to get comfortable at the top.

features.title: Armrests that adjust to you
features.text: Find the perfect arm position with height-adjustable arms, designed to align with your desk and reduce shoulder strain.

features.title: Lumbar support that adapts
features.text: The adjustable lumbar pad moulds to your lower back, giving you personalised support and helping you maintain healthy posture.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Elite Mid Back Leatherette Ergonomic Office Chair Black
